source.body:
### Bug Description

OpenAI retires `gpt-image-1-mini` on December 1, 2026 (https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/deprecations). After that date, requests that name it fail. It is the default model of the OpenAI node's Generate an Image operation from node version 2.2:

- https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/91d943c44a008cf473e67712c02dd8ed0cfee028/packages/@n8n/nodes-langchain/nodes/vendors/OpenAi/v2/actions/image/generate.operation.ts#L43 (`default: { mode: 'list', value: 'gpt-image-1-mini' }`)

So every new Generate an Image step that keeps the default stops working on December 1. Workflows on node versions before 2.2 use the list at lines 19 to 32, and all three of its models are already retired: `dall-e-2` and `dall-e-3` on May 12, 2026, `gpt-image-1` on October 23, 2026.

### To Reproduce

1. Add an OpenAI node, Image resource, Generate an Image operation, and keep the default model.
2. Run it after December 1, 2026.
3. OpenAI rejects the request because the model is retired.

### Expected behavior

The default is a model OpenAI still serves. OpenAI's replacement is `gpt-image-2.6-sunburst` (or `gpt-image-2.6-flare`). Those models use `complexity: high` when it's left out, which may change cost and speed for existing workflows.

### Debug Info

Not applicable: found by reading the code at commit 91d943c.

### Operating System

Any

### n8n Version

Any version where the OpenAI node is 2.2 or later

### Node.js Version

Any

### Database

Any

### Execution mode

Any

### Hosting

Any

---
Found by [Since](https://since.dev), which watches code for model, API and runtime retirements and opens the fix before the date. It's free for open source, and I work on it.

Happy to open a PR if that helps.
